It scopes the timeout to the family and leaves the global config alone, which fits the intent. The spawnSync inner timeouts (10s for --help, 20s for ingest) are still below the 30s test timeout, so a slow cold start can still fail through the inner spawnSync timeout before the vitest limit applies.
